summary: CADCraft is a free program for exact 2D plans, like Autodesk AutoCAD. You draw walls, furniture and machines at their real size. You add dimensions and a title block, the box with the name and scale of the plan. CADCraft opens and saves DXF and DWG, the standard file types of architects and engineers.
use_cases: Draw your flat or a room to scale. Then plan where the sofa goes before you buy it.
Plan a workshop, garden, stand or small office with exact distances and walkways.
Print a clear PDF plan with a title block for a builder, landlord or client.
Open a DXF or DWG file from another person. Check it. Then export an image or a close-up.
story: CADCraft drew a plan of a computer room for the Compute & energy theme. This theme grew from 9% to 12% of the conversation. 41% of its posts were negative. The plan shows 20 server cabinets in 2 rows, with a cold walkway between the rows. It also shows cooling units and arrows for the air flow. It has real dimensions and a title block that says 'illustrative only'.
recipe_note: Draw shapes at exact sizes in millimetres. Save them as a DXF drawing. Print the drawing to PDF. Make a close-up image of 1 area.

assets.caption: The invented plan shows a 14 × 9 m computer room with 20 server cabinets.
assets.how: cadcraft-cli run --metric + 143 --cmd steps (style, linetype, layer.new, pline, hatch, rectang, line, arc, circle, text, dimstyle, dimlinear, dimcontinue, tablestyle, table) --save gpu_row.dxf; cadcraft-cli convert gpu_row.dxf gpu_row.png (args generated by _work/cadcraft/make_plan.py)
assets.description: CADCraft drew the room from a list of 143 steps. The plan has walls, a door, 20 server cabinets, cooling units and arrows for the air flow. It also has dimensions, a table and a title block. Then CADCraft saved the plan as an image.

assets.caption: The PDF file of the plan is ready to print.
assets.description: CADCraft printed the same plan to a sharp PDF on white paper. You can enlarge it on screen, share it or print it.

assets.caption: The close-up shows the ends of the cabinet rows, 2 small coolers and the large air coolers.
assets.how: cadcraft-cli convert gpu_row.dxf gpu_row_detail.png --window 6400,1000,14400,6400; transcoded with photocraft-cli convert gpu_row_detail.png gpu_row_detail.jpg --quality 88
assets.description: CADCraft drew this close-up of 1 area of the plan as a PNG image. PhotoCraft then converted it to a smaller JPEG file. The arrows show how cold air goes to the cabinets and how warm air returns.

assets.caption: Download the drawing as a DXF file, with its lines in 16 groups (layers).
assets.description: This is the original drawing file. Its 16 layers sort the lines into groups, for example walls, cabinets, cooling, air flow and dimensions. Most technical drawing programs can open it.

assets.caption: Download the same drawing as a DWG file.
assets.description: CADCraft also saved the drawing in the AutoCAD DWG format. A check of the file found all 125 drawing objects.

assets.caption: Download an SVG version of the plan that stays sharp at every size, in a ZIP file.
assets.how: HATCH_FACTOR=4 python make_plan.py gpu_row_lite.dxf; cadcraft-cli convert gpu_row_lite.dxf gpu_row.svg; zipped with Python zipfile (7 MB unzipped)
assets.description: This SVG version of the plan is for the web. It uses fewer fill lines to make the file smaller. CADCraft saved the text as shapes. These shapes make the file large. The ZIP file makes the download smaller.

headless_notes: cadcraft-cli run --cmd built the drawing from structured commands, with no window. convert made the PNG (dark background), the PDF and the SVG (white paper). The --window option made the close-up. Near-white lines disappear on white paper. For this reason, the text uses colour 7, which prints black. The SVG file is large because text becomes outlines and each hatch becomes many short lines. The SVG uses coarser hatches and comes as a ZIP file.
